Ongoing Server

Linux home server

My general-purpose home server: Ubuntu Server with Plex and Minecraft servers through PufferPanel, all in Docker and managed with Portainer. I built and set it up myself, and I've used Codex to diagnose problems and check fixes. Next, I plan to manage its configuration from a GitHub repository.

Running since 2023. Latest update, October 14, 2026: moved to new hardware and confirmed that Watchtower's updates still run.

About

Projects I build
for myself

I'm a corporate banking analyst in New York. I'm interested in how technology companies build and run their products, and I build these projects to learn that side of the work: how a product is planned, built, and maintained, and the tradeoffs and checks behind each decision.

I use AI tools (mainly Codex, Cursor, and Claude) for much of the implementation. The project pages separate my decisions and hands-on work from how I used AI tools and what they produced, and say who ran each check.
